scripts.dev:api: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vitest run && vite build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --port 4173
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
